 Source Citation

*The Los Angeles Times*, Los Angeles, CA, Wed., Dec. 16, 1998, p. 48
 Transcription

**NORMAN, Bee Neel**, 87, passed away on December 11, 1998. Retired from Technicolor Corp. Bee was a resident of North Hollywood for nearly forty years. She was the beloved wife of Geoffrey Norman, who passed away in 1985. Bee is survived by her sons, Richard Ellard, of Valencia and Robert Howard, of Fairhaven, Washington; her step-daughter, Jozanne Dyer, of South Hampton, England; and her step-niece, Caroline Reisch of Wolfsburg, Germany. Known for her independence, wit and beauty, Bee will be greatly missed by her family, friends and neighbors.

A private gathering in her memory is pending.

In lieu of flowers, donations may be made in Bee's memory to a charity of one's choice.
